instruction: Buy 2 identical wireless earbuds from amazon with at least 6 reviews and at least 3.9 rating. Deliver one to my parents' home with gift wrapping and one to my home without gift wrapping.
notes: Two separate orders of the same product object (wireless-earbuds) guarantee identical products with one unit each; amazon.place_order empties the cart, and clear_cart_first=true on add_product_to_cart guards against pre-existing cart items so each order has exactly one item with quantity 1. Gift wrapping is tracked with a cart-wrap status (constants wrapped/unwrapped); static order-wrap and order-destination facts force the gift-wrapped order to go to the parents' address and the plain one to the supervisor's home, which mirrors the evaluation. Product eligibility: search_products with min_product_rating=3.9 gives rating-ok; show_product (or alternatively show_product_rating_distribution / show_product_reviews) confirms >= 6 reviews (reviews-ok). The parents' home address is read from phone.search_contacts(relationship="parent") (verify the exact label with phone.show_contact_relationships if needed), parsed into components and registered with amazon.add_address (address additions are ignored by evaluation; if the parents' address already exists in amazon.show_addresses it may be reused). supervisor-complete-task takes the two order records as non-API parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal; no answer is passed.
